summary.text: A 72-year-old woman with a long history of pemphigus herpetiformis had recurrent bouts with significant eosinophilia and multiple annular erythematous papules and vesicles.

Skin biopsy at diagnosis showed spongiotic dermatitis with abundant eosinophils; direct immunofluorescence was positive for IgG and C3 and serum DSG1, DSG3, BPAG180 and BP230 antibodies were negative.
Dapsone resolved lesions but was stopped for elevated creatinine; lesions recurred and rituximab gave improvement that recurred months later.
Dupilumab was started (600 mg loading dose, then 300 mg every other week) with complete resolution of lesions within 3 months and total control at 10-month follow-up.
